units.source_text: 匂亲王自从数月前某日傍晚与浮舟邂逅相遇以来，对她至今不能忘怀。

en.t: Ever since Prince Niou had happened to meet Ukifune one evening several months before, he had been unable to forget her.

units.source_text: 他回忆此女虽非身份高贵之人，但品貌十分端详，实在非常可爱。

en.t: He remembered that although she was not a woman of high rank, her manner and appearance were very refined, and she was truly charming.

units.source_text: 此君原是好色之徒，那天仅能一握其手，于心终不餍足，思之不胜后悔。

en.t: This prince was by nature a man of amorous tastes, and since that day he had only been able to clasp her hand, he remained unsatisfied and could not stop regretting it.

units.source_text: 他又埋怨二女公子，怪她为了这些些小事，便如此嫉妒，把此女隐藏。

en.t: He also resented the Second Princess, blaming her for being so jealous over such a trifling matter that she had hidden the woman away.

units.source_text: 因此常常责备她“太无情义”。

en.t: Because of this, he often reproached her as being "far too heartless."

units.source_text: 二女公子不胜其苦，曾经想把此女来历向他如实说明。

en.t: The Second Princess found this so painful that she once considered telling him truthfully about the woman's background.

units.source_text: 但她又想：“薰大将虽然不会把浮舟当作正式的妻房，但对她的爱情甚深，所以把她隐藏起来。

en.t: But then she thought, "Although General Kaoru will not treat Ukifune as a formal wife, his love for her is very deep, and that is why he has hidden her away.

units.source_text: 我倘多嘴多舌地说穿了实情，匂亲王定然不肯就此罢休。

en.t: If I were to talk too much and reveal the truth, Prince Niou would certainly not be willing to leave matters there.

units.source_text: 此人本性实在不良，我身边的侍女之中，凡是偶因几句戏言而被他看中了的人，他都不肯放过，连不应该去的地方也会去追寻。

en.t: His nature is truly improper; among the women who serve me, whenever a few playful words happened to catch his interest, he would not let the woman go, and would even pursue her to places where he ought not go.

units.source_text: 何况他对这浮舟数月以来不能忘怀，一旦被他找到，定会做出不好看的事来。

en.t: How much more so, then, when he has been unable to forget this Ukifune for months; if he were to find her, he would surely do something unseemly.

units.source_text: 如果他从别处探知，那就无可如何了。

en.t: If he learns of it from somewhere else, then there will be nothing I can do.

units.source_text: 此事对薰大将和浮舟两方都很不利，然而此人生性如此，我实无力防止。

en.t: This matter would be very harmful to both General Kaoru and Ukifune, yet since this is simply his nature, I truly have no power to prevent it.

units.source_text: 万一有事，我是她的姐姐，自然更觉可耻。

en.t: If anything should happen, I am her elder sister, so naturally I would feel even more ashamed.

units.source_text: 但无论如何，我总不可轻举妄动，惹是生非。”

en.t: But whatever happens, I must not act rashly and invite trouble."

units.source_text: 她如此想定之后，心虽担忧，口上一言不发。

en.t: After she had settled on this thought, although she was anxious at heart, she did not say a single word aloud.

units.source_text: 她也并不另外捏造理由来哄骗搪塞，只装作世间普通女子嫉妒的模样，默不作声。

en.t: Nor did she invent some other excuse to deceive him or put him off; she merely pretended to be jealous like an ordinary woman and remained silent.
